title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.22.1530
body_markdown:
* Fixed exception `Assertion failed: Please don't register startup activities for the default project: they won't ever be run`
* Reliably dispose suggestion inlays of GitHub Copilot when moving the text caret using the keyboard
* Fixed distorted suggestion inlays in the editor, e.g. after invoking the "Delete Line" action
* Don't show "Open Copilot" intention at positions where suggestions of GitHub Copilot are unavailable
* Improved insertion of suggestions by TAB on lines with non-empty prefix
* Fixed exception `Detected document modification from DocumentListener`
* Don't show suggestions for files larger than one megabyte
